# Royal Heritage Resort

A premium heritage-inspired luxury resort offering boutique glamping and cottage stays nestled in mountains.

## Core Information
- **Location**: Near Hills, District, State, India — 000000
- **Primary Contact**: +91 00000 00000 | reservations@royalheritageresort.com
- **Check-in/out**: Check-in at 2:00 PM, Check-out at 11:00 AM.
- **Pet Policy**: Pets are not permitted on the resort premises due to surrounding natural forest zones.
- **Cancellation Policy**: Full refund available on cancellations requested up to 48 hours prior to check-in.

## Accommodations
- **Royal Safari Tent**:
  - Description: Premium 350 sq. ft. canvas tent with custom heritage interior textiles and brass details.
  - Features: King bed, en-suite bathroom with hot shower, private wood veranda, mountain view.
  - Base Tariffs: ₹8,500 per night (plus taxes).
- **Heritage Stone Cottage**:
  - Description: Traditional hand-built stone 550 sq. ft. cottage with exposed beams and rustic charm.
  - Features: Twin or king bed options, living area, private garden enclosure, wood-burning fireplace.
  - Base Tariffs: ₹12,000 per night (plus taxes).

## Amenities & Activities
- **The Royal Table Restaurant**: Authentic heritage recipes, organic farm-to-table salads, open-air candlelit spaces.
- **Ayurvedic Spa & Wellness**: Ayurvedic oil massage therapies, sauna, meditation walks, and wellness packages.
- **Infinity Pool**: Temperature-controlled cliffside pool with valley viewpoints.
- **Activities**: Nature hikes, archery range, rock climbing walls, evening stargazing, campfire assemblies, cycling.
